title: Inline information popovers
brief: Palabra completa como trigger con apertura automática al hover; ? pequeño pero visible al final. Conservar botón independiente. Panel contextual menos invasivo, altura máxima, scroll al desbordar y ajuste a pantallas estrechas. Diseño únicamente; sin implementación en app/.

artboards.title: Editorial superscript
artboards.tradeoff: Quietest in long text; the superscript needs deliberate contrast to remain discoverable.

artboards.title: Visible question badge
artboards.tradeoff: Easiest to discover and consistent with map help; repeated circles add more visual noise.

artboards.title: Glossary underline
artboards.tradeoff: Clearly marks the full interactive phrase; dotted underlines make dense passages busier.
